title: New Redken Assistant Marketing Manager + two Moët Hennessy ABMs
intro: One strong new L'Oréal find posted yesterday: Assistant Marketing Manager for Redken Hair Color in New York (1–3 years — a realistic level for you). Also newly numbered two Moët Hennessy Associate Brand Manager roles (Dom Pérignon and Krug & Ruinart) that were live on LVMH's board but not on your list yet — both stretches. Your LA favorites #20 and #3 are still open, and Erborian #10 is still on L'Occitane's board.

sections.title: New today
sections.intro: Verified live Oct 15. Redken is the clearest fit; the two champagne ABMs are luxury brand seats with Maison ties to France.

sections.title: Still open (favorites)
sections.intro: Spot-checked live this morning on careers.loreal.com and L'Occitane's applytojob board.

notes: SMCP Group: Greenhouse still NY corporate (AR, Allocation Planner Maje, EA) + retail only — no US marketing/brand/partnerships.
L'Oréal Assistant Manager, Social and Content (PPD DMI) #16 is live again on careers.loreal.com (was 404 on Oct 12).
Pernod Ricard Manager, Senior Field Marketing (Los Angeles) still live but 7+ years — too senior to number.
Accor Senior Manager, Brand Marketing (Raffles, New York) live but 6+ years luxury hospitality — too senior.
Hennessy Associate Brand Manager (MHUS01213) returned 404 today — not numbered.
Polène / ba&sh Americas / Sézane / Interparfums company boards: no new confirmed US marketing openings.
None of today's new postings explicitly lists travel to Paris (Redken notes domestic travel up to 25%).

jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager, Redken US (Hair Color)
jobs.work_arrangement: Hybrid (3 days in office, 2 from home)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Redken is in the Professional Products Division.
jobs.travel: Domestic travel periodically, up to 25% — posting does not mention Paris
jobs.why: Real assistant brand-marketing seat on Redken's U.S. demi-permanent haircolor category: 360° plans, launches, SalonCentric, social/digital, sampling, and e-commerce — with only 1–3 years required. Closest new role today to a realistic entry from AE + college marketing internships.
jobs.title_note: Careers site short title is "Asst Mgr - Marketing- Hair Color"; role body is Assistant Marketing Manager, Redken US (Hair Color).

jobs.title: Associate Brand Manager, Dom Pérignon
jobs.french_tie: LVMH; Dom Pérignon Maison — you'd support brand programming aligned with Maison strategy.
jobs.why: Champagne brand seat supporting Dom Pérignon's U.S. marketing programs, activations, A&P, and luxury POS with commercial and trade partners — French Maison brand with global prestige.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–5 years of progressive brand marketing or experiential management in luxury, fine wine & spirits, or prestige lifestyle.

jobs.title: Associate Brand Manager, Krug & Ruinart
jobs.french_tie: LVMH; Krug & Ruinart Maisons — posting names liaison work with Maison teams in France.
jobs.travel: Maison visits listed among hosting experiences; posting does not specify Paris travel frequency
jobs.why: Luxury champagne brand programs and high-end experiential hosting (VIP dinners, chef partnerships, Maison visits) with an explicit operational liaison to Maison teams in France — strong France-facing brand work.
jobs.stretch_note: Asks for 3–5 years of progressive brand marketing or experiential management in luxury goods, fine wine & spirits, or prestige lifestyle.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager, Global Brand Partnerships (NYX Professional Makeup)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); NYX's global brand partnerships team.
jobs.why: Still the strongest LA fit: partnerships with fandoms and communities, no minimum years listed.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Global Marketing (Youth to the People)
jobs.french_tie: L'Oréal (Paris HQ); Youth To The People global marketing.
jobs.why: Still open — the role you already asked for a tailored resume for.

jobs.title: Trade Marketing Associate Manager, Erborian
jobs.work_arrangement: About 2 days a week in the office
